name: framework_v2
kind: engineering (no performance claim, no new data)
note: This study adds framework mechanisms, not an idea: no data was downloaded and every input it reads is already committed. The hashes below are the inputs the new code actually touches (the main window and the tax calendar, plus the extra series the two probe fixtures use), so a reader can reproduce the geometry of the reduced windows (2004-11-19 for gld, 2002-07-31 for ief).

data/historical/stress_robustness_v1_dai.role: QQQ/SPY/QLD* daily bars, the main window (fe_data.bars())

data/historical/stress_robustness_v1_dtb.role: DTB3, the 2x leg's financing and the idle-cash schedule

data/historical/batch_screen_v1_gld.csv.role: GLD adjusted close (extra key `gld`), probe two_leg/gld_offstate/sleeve

data/historical/batch_screen_v1_ief.csv.role: IEF adjusted close (extra key `ief`), the extra key the window rules are tested on

data/historical/batch_screen_v1_dgs10.cs.role: FRED DGS10 (extra key `dgs10`), the interior-NaN leg-B regression on a bootstrap chunk

registry.note: the framework's own extra-data registry declares every series' file, column, source URL, date range and SHA-256; `python -m research.batch_screen.extra --verify` re-hashes them

engine.research/fast_engine/PARITY.json: the engine's own parity artifact, restored after every harness run (the harness keeps its committed bytes)
